definition: a machine that moves water or air
description: On a frosty village street on a cold winter morning, with stone cottages behind, a young woman in a knitted hat and a navy quilted jacket pushes down the long curved iron handle of an old cast-iron hand pump. A strong stream of water gushes from its spout into a metal bucket, fills it and splashes over the cobbles. A queue of villagers with buckets, metal milk churns and a wheelbarrow waits behind her, and a golden-brown dog drinks from the stone trough.
